Class Individual

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Individual
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AgentView
Direct Known Subclasses:
Symbiont
@Deprecated public class Individual extends Object implements Serializable, AgentView
Deprecated.
Use org.swarmforge.core.ecs.components.* and org.swarmforge.core.ecs.systems.* instead.
Represents an individual eusocial insect in the simulation. Uses a sealed interface for type-safe caste representation.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
